name: breadcrumbs
description: Accessible breadcrumb navigation with Schema.org BreadcrumbList microdata for posts, tags, and authors.

current.description: Optional override for the current page title.

files.name: breadcrumbs.hbs
files.content:
{{!-- Styling parameters: class, listClass, linkClass, currentClass --}} {{#with this as |ghostcnStyles|}}
  1. {{#if homeLabel}}{{homeLabel}}{{else}}Home{{/if}}
    2. {{#if primary_tag}}
  2. {{primary_tag.name}}
    3. {{/if}}
  3. {{#if current}}{{current}}{{else}}{{#if title}}{{title}}{{else}}{{#if name}}{{name}}{{else}}{{@site.title}}{{/if}}{{/if}}{{/if}}
{{/with}}

files.name: breadcrumbs.css

gscan.notes: Uses native Ghost @site.url, primary_tag, title, and name helpers with Schema.org microdata.
